subject: Quick automation idea for www.microsoft.com
body:
Hi,

I noticed www.microsoft.com mentions repetitive, enterprise on their site.

I build custom automation bots that handle exactly this kind of work.

For a similar project, I delivered:
- Ongoing automation maintenance + new workflows
- Delivery in ongoing
- Price: $1,000-$2,000/mo (fixed scope, no long-term contract)

If this sounds useful, I can send a 2-minute demo of a comparable build.

Best,
MECOS Automation
